description: Search registered Design, Memory, Reference, and Skill sources. Provide at least one of `lexicalQuery` or `semanticQuery`. Returns ranked plain-text results with a directly readable real file path and 1-based physical line range. Workspace files use workspace-relative paths; registered sources outside the workspace use absolute physical paths. Frontmatter lines are part of the physical line coordinate system. Result titles are omitted because each title is identical to its file name. Use `read` with the returned path, offset, and limit.

lexicalQuery.description: Optional lexical query for exact terms, titles, paths, identifiers, or short keyword combinations.

semanticQuery.description: Optional semantic query for intent- or meaning-based retrieval using natural language.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5, max: 20).

pathPrefix.description: Optional type-prefixed directory path prefix. Valid roots: `design/`, `memory/`, `skill/`, and `reference/`. Use `skill/` for workflows, SOPs, slash-command skills, tool/package instructions, and reusable execution procedures. Examples: `skill/`, `skill/unity/`, `memory/`, `design/`, `reference/unity/`. Directory prefixes do not end with `.md`.

includeSummary.description: Whether to include each document summary. When false, results return `summary_start_line` and `body_start_line` for targeted reads instead.

includeHitContext.description: Whether to return a `context` block containing source text nearest to each hit so its meaning can be checked directly. Context is split on punctuation and line boundaries and capped by `hitContextMaxChars`.

hitContextMaxChars.description: Maximum characters of hit context to return per result (default: 220, min: 80, max: 1000). Only used when `includeHitContext` is true.
